jQuery(function ($) {

  $.ajax({
    url: wdhubJobData.ajaxUrl,
    type: "POST",
    data: {
      action: "get_wdhub_job"
    },

    success: function (response) {

      console.log("FULL RESPONSE:", response);

      if (!response.success) {
        console.error("Error:", response.data);
        return;
      }

      const data = response.data;

      if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
        console.error("Data is not array");
        return;
      }

      // Clear all tables
      $("#cariadBody").empty();
      $("#pesBody").empty();
      $("#dsBody").empty();
      $("#dataAiBody").empty();
      $("#corporateBody").empty();
      $("#result2Body").empty();
      $("#buDropdown").find("option:not(:first)").remove();

      const otherJobs = [];

      data.forEach(job => {

        if (!job || !job.bu) return;

        const buLower = job.bu.toLowerCase();
        const buNormalized = buLower.replace(/_/g, ' ');
        const jobbu = job.bu.replace(/_/g, ' ');

        console.log("JOB:", job);

        // ==========================
        // Cariad Table
        // ==========================
        if (buNormalized.includes("cariad")) {

          const li = `
            <li>
             <p class="designation"> ${job.designation || ''}</p>
              <p class="location">Location: ${job.location || ''}</p>
              <p class="link"><a href="${job.job_url}" target="_blank">Apply</a></p>
            </li>
          `;

          $("#cariadBody").append(li);
        }
        // ==========================
        // Product Engineering Services
        // ==========================
        else if (buNormalized.includes("product engineering services")) {
 console.log("? PES MATCH FOUND:", job);
  console.log("BU RAW:", job.bu);
  console.log("BU NORMALIZED:", buNormalized);
          appendToTable(job, "#pesBody");
        }

        // ==========================
        // Digital Solutions
        // ==========================
        else if (buNormalized.includes("digital solutions")) {
          appendToTable(job, "#dsBody");
        }

        // ==========================
        // Data and AI  
        // ==========================
        else if (
          buNormalized.includes("data & ai") ||
          buNormalized.includes("data ai")
        ) {
          appendToTable(job, "#dataAiBody");
        }

        // ==========================
        //Corporate Functions
        // ==========================
        else if (
          buNormalized.includes("corporate functions") ||
          buNormalized.includes("corporate")
        ) {
          appendToTable(job, "#corporateBody");
        }


        // ==========================
        // Others ? table + dropdown
        // ==========================
        else {
          otherJobs.push(job);
          appendRow(job);

          if ($("#buDropdown option[value='" + job.bu + "']").length === 0) {
            $("#buDropdown").append(
              new Option(jobbu, job.bu)
            );
          }
        }
      });

      // ==========================
      // Dropdown filter
      // ==========================
      $("#buDropdown").off("change").on("change", function () {

        const selectedBU = $(this).val();
        $("#result2Body").empty();

        if (!selectedBU) {
          displayTable(otherJobs);
        } else {
          const filtered = otherJobs.filter(job =>
            job.bu === selectedBU
          );
          displayTable(filtered);
        }
      });

      // ==========================
      // Functions
      // ==========================

      function appendToTable(job, selector) {
        const jobbu = job.bu.replace(/_/g, ' ');

        const row = `
          <tr>
            <td>${jobbu}</td>
            <td>${job.designation || ''}</td>
            <td>${job.location || ''}</td>
            <td><a href="${job.job_url}" target="_blank">Apply</a></td>
          </tr>
        `;

        $(selector).append(row);
      }

      function appendRow(job) {
        const jobbu = job.bu.replace(/_/g, ' ');

        const row = `
          <tr>
            <td>${jobbu}</td>
            <td>${job.designation || ''}</td>
            <td>${job.location || ''}</td>
            <td><a href="${job.job_url}" target="_blank">Apply</a></td>
          </tr>
        `;

        $("#result2Body").append(row);
      }

      function displayTable(jobs) {
        if (!jobs.length) {
          $("#result2Body").append(
            `<tr><td colspan="4">No jobs found</td></tr>`
          );
          return;
        }

        jobs.forEach(job => appendRow(job));
      }

    },

    error: function (xhr, status, error) {
      console.error("AJAX FAILED:", error);
    }

  });

});
